# captured 2026-09-22
# exe: /home/ubuntu/.local/bin/trivy
# args: 
Manage registry authentication

Usage:
  trivy registry [command]

Available Commands:
  login       Log in to a registry
  logout      Log out of a registry

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for registry

Global Flags:
      --cacert string             Path to PEM-encoded CA certificate file
      --cache-dir string          cache directory (default "/home/ubuntu/.cache/trivy")
  -c, --config string             config path (default "trivy.yaml")
  -d, --debug                     debug mode
      --generate-default-config   write the default config to trivy-default.yaml
      --insecure                  allow insecure server connections
  -q, --quiet                     suppress progress bar and log output
      --timeout duration          timeout (default 5m0s)
  -v, --version                   show version

Use "trivy registry [command] --help" for more information about a command.
